notes: **2026-09-04** — (branch `fix/F13-recurring-standing-v2`, F13 close-out; no schema change, no migration) **RECURRING INVOICES + STANDING ORDERS (B46/B48/B106 T1, B09/B92 T2).** B46: `calcNextRunAt`'s MONTHLY branch compared `getDate() > dom` against a date it had already mutated with `setDate(1)`, so the test was always `1 > dom` and no MONTHLY template ever advanced — the midnight cron re-selected it nightly; the branch now derives the next occurrence from `from` itself, clamps `dayOfMonth` to 1..31 (an unclamped 0 made the advance loop non-terminating and hung the cron with the API process), and the cycle claim advances from `max(dueDate, now)` so a months-behind template is caught up by ONE make-up invoice instead of one per night. B48: `order-templates.service.generateOrder` billed raw `product.pricePerUnit` and now prices every line through the shared buyer resolver — `OrdersService.loadActivePromotions` and `resolveBuyerLinePrice` dropped `private` and are a CONTRACT now, never to be forked — so tier, per-product `CustomerPrice` override, active promotions incl. BUY_N_GET_M free units, the sticky-upsell price memory and boxed selling units all apply to a standing order exactly as to the buyer's own checkout. B106: the cron advanced the schedule before it knew the outcome and recorded none — the CAS claim now stamps a provisional FAILED/`RUN_INTERRUPTED_ERROR`, SUCCESS is written LAST (after the invoice is created AND linked), the billed-but-unfinalized path keeps the advanced date and rewrites `lastError` to `RUN_UNFINALIZED_ERROR` (web mirrors it as `RUN_UNFINALIZED_PREFIX` — coupled by a `startsWith`, reword neither alone), and the create-failure rollback is a **compare-and-set on the advanced `nextRunAt` this run's own claim wrote**: `count: 0` means a newer claimant owns the row and may already have billed the cycle, so it logs at warn and writes nothing while still rethrowing. B92: `PATCH /recurring-invoices/:id` had no DTO class at all (an inline mapped type erases to `Object` in `design:paramtypes`, so the global ValidationPipe skipped the body entirely) — new `UpdateRecurringInvoiceDto extends PartialType(CreateRecurringInvoiceDto)`, deliberately without `isActive`, plus a real edit page `invoices/recurring/[id]/edit` over `RecurringInvoiceForm` extracted verbatim from `new/page.tsx`. B09: `UpdateOrderTemplateDto` gains `items` (reusing the now-exported `OrderTemplateItemDto`), `update()` validates the products then replaces the lines in ONE `tenantTransaction`, and the Edit Standing Order modal sends `items` only when the list actually changed (order-free `itemSignature`) so a scalar-only edit keeps working across the api/web deploy window. Web recurring cards show the recorded outcome with the retry hint gated by `isRetryableRunFailure`; mobile mirrors it with the pure `lastRunOutcome`. New e2e `30-recurring-standing.spec.ts` + its `recurring-standing` playwright project (⚠️ `DELETE /recurring-invoices/:id` is DEACTIVATE, not a row delete). `scripts/data-integrity-report.mjs` gains three B48 checks: the current-basis candidate set, a positive control, and a gate-state row set. Lesson **L-046** (domain).
